models_evaluated: CoMET (Continuous Monitoring of Event Trajectories) predictive analytics display

links.outcome: Hours free of clinical deterioration events and 21-day mortality with AI risk display versus usual care
links.effect: No change in primary outcome between groups; more event-free hours among those with events in display-on group, not statistically significant; predictive analytics with education did not improve patient outcomes.
links.quote: Predictive analytics monitoring incorporating continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring and displays of risk trajectories coupled with an education plan did not improve patient outcomes.

unlisted_practices: Passive display of AI risk trajectories without mandated response

screen.reason: This pragmatic randomized controlled trial tested the clinical impact of deploying a passive visual display of continuous AI-based risk trajectories coupled with staff education compared to usual care on an inpatient cardiology ward.

primary.practice: passive visual display of risk trajectories with staff training
